mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within the last month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings face headwinds, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed's actions dampen economic growth and corporate profits.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS growth and 20d SPX returns is not significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 in the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 does not lead to negative 5d SPX returns in at least 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches recession.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce negative 60d returns in at least 65% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 450000), a decline in retail sales below 445000 within the past month signals a loss of consumer momentum, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 450000 and RSAFS falls below 445000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
